# realpath

Resolve and normalize paths through MoonX.

Readlink also uses this command's physical and lexical resolver for its canonicalization modes.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/realpath existing.txt

moonx cli/realpath -m missing/path

moonx cli/realpath --relative-to=. existing.txt
```

Resolve path components and symbolic links. Select existing-only, missing-component or lexical normalization behavior explicitly.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-e`, `--canonicalize-existing` | require every component to exist |
| `-m`, `--canonicalize-missing` | allow missing or non-directory components |
| `-s`, `--strip` | do not expand symbolic links |
| `-z`, `--zero` | terminate output with NUL |
| `--relative-to VALUE` | print relative to DIR |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Physical resolution requires readable link targets. Lexical mode does not establish physical containment.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
